entities.name: Silas Brotten

entities.name: Ulf

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Planeswalker from Corondor who killed Silas.

events.summary: Silas reveals his Phyrexian form while trying to seize Ulf's book.
events.quote: He ultimately revealed his Phyrexian nature, shedding his human guise

events.summary: Silas murders Ulf's roommates and Thranegeld searching for the book.
